messages:
rina-ops: FYI scheduling a short rolling maintenance window 01:15-02:00 UTC for apac-edge to apply NIC microcode and reboot a couple of nodes. Expect brief p95 blips and ~6% capacity dip. Plan: cordon -> drain -> reboot -> kvseed -> smoke test.

devin-infra: ack. which racks/nodes? any reserved backfill?

rina-ops: targets: apac-edge-rack-02 node-05 and apac-edge-rack-03 node-02. We'll spin up 2 temporary burst nodes (dedicated-burst-temp) for 50m to smooth traffic.

omar-sre: tagging @anya-mlops and runbook. Abort criteria: p95 > 600ms for 10m or error-rate >1.5x. If abort, reroute fully to eu/us and spawn extra burst. I'll monitor SLOs.

anya-mlops: please set a 5% canary for 7m after kvseed so I can run a quick quality + latency check. Canary model: gptx-3-small:canary-2026-03.

rina-ops: commands we'll run:
`infractl cordon node apac-edge-rack-02-05`
`infractl drain node apac-edge-rack-02-05 --grace 60`
`infractl reboot node apac-edge-rack-02-05 --warm`
`infractl kvseed --node apac-edge-rack-02-05 --primer apac-primer-v3`
`infractl route-set canary gptx-3-small:canary-2026-03 --pct 5`

devin-infra: cost note: burst nodes estimate +$210 for window. ticket CT-2026-499 created.

deploy-bot: Maintenance ticket INC-2026-2122 created; preflight reminder 00:55 UTC.

omar-sre: I'll post minute-by-minute snapshots to #inc-ops-live and escalate on breaches. See you for preflight at 01:00 UTC.

rina-ops: Thanks team  will post short support blurb 30m before and update status page if anything prolonged. :thumbsup:
